```{r}
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(here)
library(tools)

# spatial
library(terra)
library(amt) # ssf
library(moveHMM)

# terra masks dplyr::select() -- reclaim it once here rather than patching every call site
select <- dplyr::select
```

```{r}
# ----- loading data -----
ele_data0 <- read_csv(here("data", "elephant_2010-Feb2020.csv"))
```

```{r}
# cleaning data
ele_clean0 <- ele_data0 |> 
  clean_names() |> 
  mutate(dt = mdy_hm(dt)) |> 
  mutate(season = case_when(
    month %in% c(5:10) ~ "dry",
    month %in% c(1:4, 11:12) ~ "wet"
  ))

```


```{r}
# separating by season
ele_dry <- ele_clean0 |> 
  filter(season == "dry")

ele_wet <- ele_clean0 |> 
  filter(season == "wet")

# HMM combined season track (unsplit -- needed for continuous-track HMM fitting)
ele_trk_all <- ele_clean0 |>
  make_track(.x = lon, .y = lat, .t = dt, id = id, season = season, crs = 4326)

# structure tracking data
ele_trk_dry <- make_track(ele_dry,
                      .x = lon, .y = lat, .t = dt,
                      id = id, crs = 4326)

ele_trk_wet <- make_track(ele_wet,
                      .x = lon, .y = lat, .t = dt,
                      id = id, crs = 4326)
```

```{r}
summarize_sampling_rate(ele_trk_dry, time_unit = "sec")
summarize_sampling_rate(ele_trk_wet, time_unit = "sec")

```

# Step 2
```{r}
#| include: false
resample_trk <- function(trk) {
  trk |> 
  nest(data = -id) |> 
  mutate(steps = map(data, function(x) {
    x |>
      track_resample(rate = hours(1), tolerance = minutes(15)) |>
      steps_by_burst()
  })) |>
  dplyr::select(id, steps) |>   # <-- explicit, since terra::select() masks this
  unnest(cols = steps)
}

random_steps_by_id <- function(reg_trk) {
  reg_trk |>
    nest(data = -id) |>
    mutate(data = map(data, ~ random_steps(.x, n = 10))) |>
    mutate(data = map2(data, id, ~ mutate(.x, id = .y))) |>
    pull(data) |>
    bind_rows()
}

#set.seed(123)
#ele_dry_reg <- resample_trk(ele_trk_dry) |> random_steps_by_id()
#ele_wet_reg <- resample_trk(ele_trk_wet) |> random_steps_by_id()
```

```{r}
# resample full combined track
ele_all_reg <- resample_trk(ele_trk_all)

season_lookup <- ele_trk_all |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  select(id, t_, season)

ele_all_reg <- ele_all_reg |>
  left_join(season_lookup, by = c("id" = "id", "t1_" = "t_"))

# drop single-row bursts BEFORE building hmm_data -- keeps hmm_data and
# ele_all_reg row-aligned throughout, so state attaches positionally,
# no join needed later (a join here caused a 16GB memory crash previously)
ele_all_reg <- ele_all_reg |>
  mutate(hmm_burst_id = paste(id, burst_, sep = "_")) |>
  add_count(hmm_burst_id, name = "burst_n") |>
  filter(burst_n >= 2) |>
  select(-burst_n)

cat("rows after dropping single-row bursts:", nrow(ele_all_reg), "\n")
```


```{r}
hmm_data <- ele_all_reg |>
  transmute(ID = hmm_burst_id, step = sl_, angle = ta_) |>
  as.data.frame()

hmm_data$step[hmm_data$step == 0] <- 1e-6
class(hmm_data) <- c("moveData", class(hmm_data))

nrow(hmm_data) == nrow(ele_all_reg)  # CHECK: TRUE

step_mean0  <- c(quantile(hmm_data$step, .25, na.rm = TRUE), quantile(hmm_data$step, .75, na.rm = TRUE))
step_sd0    <- step_mean0
angle_mean0 <- c(0, 0)
angle_conc0 <- c(0.5, 3)

hmm_fit <- fitHMM(data = hmm_data, nbStates = 2,
                   stepPar0 = c(step_mean0, step_sd0),
                   anglePar0 = c(angle_mean0, angle_conc0),
                   formula = ~1)
hmm_fit
```
```{r}
fast_state <- as.integer(which.max(hmm_fit$mle$stepPar["mean", ]))
decoded_states <- viterbi(hmm_fit)

length(decoded_states) == nrow(ele_all_reg)  # >>> CHECK: TRUE, positional assignment safe

ele_all_reg$movement_state <- ifelse(decoded_states == fast_state, "fast", "encamped")
table(ele_all_reg$movement_state, ele_all_reg$season, useNA = "ifany")
```

```{r}
# random steps per subset
fit_pooled_sl_distr <- function(trk) {
  sl <- trk$sl_
  sl[sl == 0] <- 1e-6
  fit <- fitdistrplus::fitdist(sl, distr = "gamma")
  amt::make_gamma_distr(shape = fit$estimate["shape"], scale = 1 / fit$estimate["rate"])
}

# four season x state subsets (from ele_all_reg, after state attached above)
ele_dry_fast_trk     <- ele_all_reg |> filter(season == "dry", movement_state == "fast")
ele_dry_encamped_trk <- ele_all_reg |> filter(season == "dry", movement_state == "encamped")
ele_wet_fast_trk     <- ele_all_reg |> filter(season == "wet", movement_state == "fast")
ele_wet_encamped_trk <- ele_all_reg |> filter(season == "wet", movement_state == "encamped")

sl_distr_dry_fast     <- fit_pooled_sl_distr(ele_dry_fast_trk)
sl_distr_dry_encamped <- fit_pooled_sl_distr(ele_dry_encamped_trk)
sl_distr_wet_fast     <- fit_pooled_sl_distr(ele_wet_fast_trk)
sl_distr_wet_encamped <- fit_pooled_sl_distr(ele_wet_encamped_trk)

random_steps_pooled_distr <- function(trk, sl_distr) {
  trk |>
    nest(data = -id) |>
    mutate(data = map(data, ~ random_steps(.x, n = 10, sl_distr = sl_distr))) |>
    mutate(data = map2(data, id, ~ mutate(.x, id = .y))) |>
    pull(data) |>
    bind_rows()
}

set.seed(123)
ele_dry_fast_reg     <- random_steps_pooled_distr(ele_dry_fast_trk,     sl_distr_dry_fast)
ele_dry_encamped_reg <- random_steps_pooled_distr(ele_dry_encamped_trk, sl_distr_dry_encamped)
ele_wet_fast_reg     <- random_steps_pooled_distr(ele_wet_fast_trk,     sl_distr_wet_fast)
ele_wet_encamped_reg <- random_steps_pooled_distr(ele_wet_encamped_trk, sl_distr_wet_encamped)

sapply(list(ele_dry_fast_reg, ele_dry_encamped_reg, ele_wet_fast_reg, ele_wet_encamped_reg), nrow)
```

```{r}
# Step 3: Prepare raster stack for environmental covariates

file_paths <- c()
gee_folder <- here("data", "500m_data")

for (file in list.files(gee_folder)[!list.files(gee_folder) %in% c("EVI data", "gpw_rast_500m.tif", "worldPop_comb_img_500m.tif")]) {
  file_paths <- c(file_paths, paste0(gee_folder,"/", file))
}


crop_extent <- ext(18.461667,  25.283338, -20.916664, -17.133330)
test_crop <- ext(12.5, 25.5, -21.5, -16.5)
target_res <- 0.0045

template <- rast(test_crop, resolution = target_res, crs = "EPSG:4326")

raster_list <- map(file_paths, function(fp) {
  r <- rast(fp)
  project(r, template, method = "bilinear")
})

raster_stack <- rast(raster_list)

which(names(raster_stack) == "distance")
names(raster_stack)[c(1, 6, 7, 8)] <- c("core_dist", "fence_dist", "river_dist", "road_dist")
```

# Step 4: Extracting covariates (x4: dry/wet x fast/encamped)

```{r}
evi_folder <- here("data", "500m_data", "EVI data")
wet_months <- c(1:4, 11:12)
dry_months <- c(5:10)

extract_evi <- function(ele_trk) {
  if("EVI" %in% colnames(ele_trk) | "evi" %in% colnames(ele_trk)){
    return(ele_trk)
  }
  ele_trk_mutated <- ele_trk
  if(!"year" %in% colnames(ele_trk)){
    ele_trk_mutated <- ele_trk_mutated |> mutate(year = year(t2_))
  }
  if(!"season" %in% colnames(ele_trk)){
    ele_trk_mutated <- ele_trk_mutated |> 
      mutate(season = case_when(
           month(t2_) %in% wet_months ~ "wet",
           month(t2_) %in% dry_months ~ "dry"))
  }
  new_dataframe <- tibble()
  for (yr in 2008:2020) {
    for (szn in c("dry", "wet")) {
      evi_extract <- ele_trk_mutated |> filter(year == yr, season == szn)
      if (nrow(evi_extract) == 0){next}
      if (szn == "dry"){
        r <- rast(paste0(evi_folder, "/", "evi_dry_", yr, ".tif"))
        evi_extract <- evi_extract |> extract_covariates(r)
      } else{
        r1 <- rast(paste0(evi_folder, "/", "evi_wet_", yr - 1,"_", yr, ".tif"))
        r2 <- rast(paste0(evi_folder, "/", "evi_wet_", yr,"_", yr + 1, ".tif"))
        sub1 <- evi_extract |> filter(month(t2_) %in% 1:4) |> extract_covariates(r1)
        sub2 <- evi_extract |> filter(month(t2_) %in% 11:12) |> extract_covariates(r2)
        evi_extract <- bind_rows(sub1, sub2)
      }
      new_dataframe <- bind_rows(new_dataframe, evi_extract)
    }
  }
  class(new_dataframe) <- class(ele_trk)
  return(new_dataframe)
}
```

```{r}
#Extraction
world_pop <- rast(here("data", "500m_data", "worldPop_comb_img_500m.tif"))
world_pop_list <- split(world_pop, 1:nlyr(world_pop))

extract_world_pop <- function(ele_trk){
  ele_trk_mutated <- ele_trk
  if(!"year" %in% colnames(ele_trk)){
    ele_trk_mutated <- ele_trk_mutated |> mutate(year = year(t2_))
  }  
  new_dataframe <- tibble()
  for(yr in 2008:2020){
    pop_extract <- ele_trk_mutated |> filter(year == yr)
    if(nrow(pop_extract) == 0){next}
    list_pos <- yr - 1999
    r <- world_pop_list[[list_pos]]
    class(pop_extract) <- class(ele_trk)
    pop_extract <- pop_extract |> 
      extract_covariates(r) |> 
      rename(world_pop = as.character(yr))
    new_dataframe <- bind_rows(new_dataframe, pop_extract)
  }
  class(new_dataframe) <- class(ele_trk)
  return(new_dataframe)
}


```

```{r}
clean_and_derive <- function(df) {
  df |>
    clean_names() |>
    mutate(log_sl = log(sl), cos_ta = cos(ta), step_id = paste(id, step_id, sep = "_"))
}

# NA endpoint filter (from earlier extract_evi debugging: ~19K rows with NA x2/y2)
prep_for_extraction <- function(df) df |> filter(!is.na(x2_), !is.na(y2_))

ele_trk_extract_dry_fast     <- ele_dry_fast_reg     |> prep_for_extraction() |> extract_covariates(raster_stack)
ele_trk_extract_dry_encamped <- ele_dry_encamped_reg |> prep_for_extraction() |> extract_covariates(raster_stack)
ele_trk_extract_wet_fast     <- ele_wet_fast_reg     |> prep_for_extraction() |> extract_covariates(raster_stack)
ele_trk_extract_wet_encamped <- ele_wet_encamped_reg |> prep_for_extraction() |> extract_covariates(raster_stack)

ele_trk_extract_dry_fast     <- extract_evi(ele_trk_extract_dry_fast)
ele_trk_extract_dry_encamped <- extract_evi(ele_trk_extract_dry_encamped)
ele_trk_extract_wet_fast     <- extract_evi(ele_trk_extract_wet_fast)
ele_trk_extract_wet_encamped <- extract_evi(ele_trk_extract_wet_encamped)

ele_trk_extract_dry_fast     <- extract_world_pop(ele_trk_extract_dry_fast)
ele_trk_extract_dry_encamped <- extract_world_pop(ele_trk_extract_dry_encamped)
ele_trk_extract_wet_fast     <- extract_world_pop(ele_trk_extract_wet_fast)
ele_trk_extract_wet_encamped <- extract_world_pop(ele_trk_extract_wet_encamped)

ele_trk_extract_dry_fast     <- clean_and_derive(ele_trk_extract_dry_fast)
ele_trk_extract_dry_encamped <- clean_and_derive(ele_trk_extract_dry_encamped)
ele_trk_extract_wet_fast     <- clean_and_derive(ele_trk_extract_wet_fast)
ele_trk_extract_wet_encamped <- clean_and_derive(ele_trk_extract_wet_encamped)

sapply(list(ele_trk_extract_dry_fast, ele_trk_extract_dry_encamped, ele_trk_extract_wet_fast, ele_trk_extract_wet_encamped), nrow)
```
# Step 5: Fitting the SSF (x4: dry/wet x fast/encamped)
```{r}
issf_formula <- case ~ sl + log_sl + cos_ta +
  core_dist + water_dist + forest_dist + crop_dist +
  built_dist + fence_dist + river_dist + road_dist +
  elevation + slope + aspect +
  evi + world_pop + strata(step_id)

m0_dry_fast     <- ele_trk_extract_dry_fast     |> fit_issf(issf_formula, model = FALSE)
m0_dry_encamped <- ele_trk_extract_dry_encamped |> fit_issf(issf_formula, model = FALSE)
m0_wet_fast     <- ele_trk_extract_wet_fast     |> fit_issf(issf_formula, model = FALSE)
m0_wet_encamped <- ele_trk_extract_wet_encamped |> fit_issf(issf_formula, model = FALSE)

summary(m0_dry_fast)
summary(m0_dry_encamped)
summary(m0_wet_fast)
summary(m0_wet_encamped)
```
